[[XL Center]] |champion= |tourney = [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = first round }} {{2021–22 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 UConn Huskies men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Connecticut]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Huskies were led by fourth-year head coach [[Dan Hurley]] in the team's second season since their return to the [[Big East Conference]]. The Huskies played their home games at the [[Harry A. Gampel Pavilion]] in [[Storrs, Connecticut]] and the [[XL Center]] in [[Hartford, Connecticut]].{{cite web| url = https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/team/_/id/41/uconn-huskies| title = UConn Huskies College Basketball - UConn News, Scores, Stats, Rumors & More - ESPN}}{{cite web|author=UConn Huskies |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/ncaab/teams/connecticut/ |title=UConn Huskies on Yahoo! Sports - News, Scores, Standings, Rumors, Fantasy Games |publisher=Sports.yahoo.com |date=2020-11-03 |accessdate=2021-11-12}} They finished the season 23–10, 13–6 in Big East play to finish in third place. UConn defeated [[2021–22 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] in the quarterfinals to advance to the semifinals of the [[2022 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] where they lost to [[2021–22 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 5 seed in the West Region, where they were upset in the First Round by [[2021–22 New Mexico State Aggies men's basketball team|New Mexico State]] 70–63. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, the [[2020–21 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the season 15–8, 11–6 in [[2020–21 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in third place. They defeated [[2020–21 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|DePaul]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] before losing [[2020–21 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]] in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 7 seed in the East Region.
